target.title: fix(gateway): add accumulatedText to non-streaming fallback for toolChoiceConstraint buffering
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When `tool_choice` constraint is set (e.g. `tool_choice: { type: "function", name: "search" }`), a `replace: true, text: "..."` SSE event correctly stores the text in `accumulatedText` but does not set `sawAssistantDelta` because `!toolChoiceConstraint` blocks the guard at line 1059. If the stream ends without `tool_calls` (error/interruption), the non-streaming fallback at line 1277 selects content from `resultPayloadText || bufferedReplaceableAssistantContent` — neither includes the buffered text, so it is silently lost.

## Why This Change Was Made

The `accumulatedText` variable already participates in the `tool_calls` path (`finalText = accumulatedText || resultPayloadText || ...` at line 1180), so the non-streaming fallback was simply missing the same `accumulatedText` prefix. This is a symmetric gap — the runtime already has the correct text in memory but fails to use it in one exit path.

## Changes

- **Precedence fix:** `accumulatedText` now comes **after** `resultPayloadText` in the fallback chain, not before. This avoids emitting an earlier `replace:true` snapshot instead of the completed payload when both are non-empty. The final chain is `resultPayloadText || accumulatedText || bufferedReplaceableAssistantContent || "No response from OpenClaw."`, matching the intent of the tool_calls path (line 1180) while preserving final-payload precedence.
- The existing `!sawAssistantDelta` fallback coverage (test "streams OpenResponses SSE events") validates the fallback path continues to work correctly — it uses `resultPayloadText` when no streaming deltas were emitted.
- **New test "includes accumulatedText in no-delta fallback when constraint prevents delta emission":** Exercises the specific L1274 fallback path with accumulatedText populated. The test emits a `replace: true` event under `tool_choice` constraint (which blocks `sawAssistantDelta`), then returns a payload with empty text but meta satisfying the constraint with `stopReason !== "tool_calls"` to reach the fallback. Without the fix, this test produces `"No response from OpenClaw."`; with the fix, it returns `"buffered draft"` from `accumulatedText`.

## Evidence

- **Focused test proving the fix:** `pnpm test src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts -t "includes accumulatedText"` passes with the fix (returns "buffered draft") and fails without it (returns "No response from OpenClaw."). See [openresponses-http.test.ts:L1469](src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts#L1469).
- Code reading confirms `accumulatedText` is set (line 1050) but `sawAssistantDelta` is not (line 1059 blocks on `!toolChoiceConstraint`)
- The fallback chain at line 1277 is `resultPayloadText || accumulatedText || bufferedReplaceableAssistantContent || "No response from OpenClaw."`
- The sibling `tool_calls` path (line 1180) correctly uses `accumulatedText || resultPayloadText || bufferedReplaceableAssistantContent` — the fix makes L1180 and L1277 consistent
- `pnpm tsgo:core` passes cleanly
